neighbours.label: 'in'/'on' as the first element of a hyphenated or fixed compound modifier (in-depth, in-game, On Demand)
fire: The magazine ran an in-depth profile of the young painter.
Players can buy in-game items with gold coins.
The cable package includes On Demand movies and sports.
Our clinic offers in-home care for elderly patients.
The company hired an in-house lawyer last year.
She gave an in-person talk to the whole department.
The airline improved its in-flight meals this winter.
This tablet has an in-built speaker and camera.
quiet: The magazine ran a long profile of the young painter.
Players can buy rare items with gold coins.
The cable package includes premium movies and sports.
Our clinic offers home visits for elderly patients.
The company hired a corporate lawyer last year.
She gave a short talk to the whole department.
The airline improved its economy meals this winter.
This tablet has a loud speaker and camera.
